environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in production VPC with task role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/order-consumer-role. The task role has s3:PutObject on the audit bucket and sqs:* on the order queue. Environment variables AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and AWS_SESSION_TOKEN are injected via task credentials. The SQS queue accepts messages from any principal with sqs:SendMessage permission, including cross-account producers. No message validation or schema enforcement on the queue. No SCP applied to the account.

config.credential_exposure: AWS temp credentials in environment variables
